



```{r}
t2m <- ERA5_t2msd() |>
  ReadNetCDF(c(t2m_sd = "t2m"), subset = list(time = range(daice$time))) |>
  _[, time := as.Date(time)] |>
  _[daice, on = .NATURAL] |>
  _[!is.na(aice)]
```

```{r}
label_to_number <- function(x) {
  levs <- utils::strcapture(
    r"([\[\(](-?\d+),(-?\d+)[\]\)])",
    levels(x),
    perl = TRUE,
    proto = list(low = integer(), high = integer())
  )

  number <- (levs$high + levs$low) / 2
  levels(x) <- number

  x |>
    as.character() |>
    as.numeric()
}
```

```{r}
t2m |>
  copy() |>
  _[,
    c("lon", "lat") := proj4::project(
      list(x, y),
      sic_projection,
      inverse = TRUE
    )
  ] |>
  _[,
    .(t2m_sd = mean(t2m_sd, na.rm = TRUE), n = .N),
    by = .(t2m = cut_t2m(t2m), lat = cut_width(lat, width = 4, center = -50))
  ] |>
  _[n > 50] |>
  ggplot(aes(t2m, t2m_sd)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = label_to_number(lat), group = lat)) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c("Latitude")
```

```{r}
minmax <- t2m |>
  _[t2m %between% c(-21, -19) | t2m %between% c(0, 2)] |>
  _[, t2m_cat := ifelse(t2m < -5, "cold", "warm")] |>
  _[, .SD[c(which.max(t2m_sd), which.min(t2m_sd))], by = .(t2m_cat)] |>
  _[,
    c("lon", "lat") := proj4::project(
      list(x, y),
      sic_projection,
      inverse = TRUE
    )
  ]

minmax[]
```



```{r}
top_and_bottom <- function(x, N) {
  n <- nrow(x)
  x[c(1:N, (n - N + 1):n)]
}


events <- t2m |>
  _[t2m %between% c(-21, -19) | t2m %between% c(0, 2)] |>
  _[, t2m_cat := ifelse(t2m < -5, "cold", "warm")] |>
  _[, top_and_bottom(.SD[order(t2m_sd)], 1), by = .(t2m_cat, time)] |>
  _[, top_and_bottom(.SD[order(t2m_sd)], 10), by = .(t2m_cat)] |>
  _[, sd_cat := ifelse(1:.N <= 10, "low", "high"), by = t2m_cat] |>
  _[, time := as.Date(time)] |>
  _[, event_id := 1:.N] |>
  _[,
    c("lon_event", "lat_event") := proj4::project(
      list(x, y),
      sic_projection,
      inverse = TRUE
    )
  ]
```

```{r}
t2m[, t2m_a := t2m - mean(t2m, na.rm = TRUE), by = .(x, y, month(time))]
```

```{r}
events[
  t2m_cat == "warm" & sd_cat == "high",
  .(time, t2m_cat, sd_cat, event_id, lon_event)
] |>
  _[event_id == event_id[1]] |>
  t2m[i = _, on = "time"] |>
  _[,
    c("lon", "lat") := proj4::project(
      list(x, y),
      sic_projection,
      inverse = TRUE
    )
  ] |>
  _[, lon := (lon - lon_event) %% 360] |>
  ggplot(aes(lon, lat)) +
  geom_raster(aes(fill = t2m_a)) +
  facet_wrap(~event_id)
```

```{r}
ranges <- list(
  as.character(events$time),
  as.character(events$time + lubridate::days_in_month(events$time) - 1)
) |>
  transpose()


events <- gadiera5::era5() |>
  _[aggregation %like% "monthly"] |>
  _[variable == "z"] |>
  gadiera5::set_date_range(ranges) |>
  gadiera5::get_files() |>
  _[, .(variable, file = unlist(files), event_id = as.integer(range_id))] |>
  _[events, on = "event_id"] |>
  _[,
    c("lon_event", "lat_event") := proj4::project(
      list(x, y),
      sic_projection,
      inverse = TRUE
    )
  ] |>
  _[,
    file := cdo_sellonlatbox(file, lon_event - 50, lon_event + 50, -90, -40)[],
    by = .(event_id, variable)
  ]
```


```{r}
events_composite <- events |>
  _[
    t2m_cat == "cold",
    ReadNetCDF(file, variable),
    by = .(t2m_cat, sd_cat, event_id, lon_event)
  ] |>
  normalise_names() |>
  _[, lon := x - floor(lon_event)] |>
  _[, .(z = mean(z)), by = .(lon, lat = y, t2m_cat, sd_cat)]
```

```{r}
events_composite |>
  copy() |>
  _[, z := z - mean(z), by = lat] |>
  ggplot(aes(lon, lat)) +
  geom_raster(aes(fill = z)) +
  facet_grid(t2m_cat ~ sd_cat)
```


```{r}
events |>
```
